why: The criterion holds, though the advisory at the end of the verifier brief is a borderline case. The verifier brief has exactly two checks, Check 1 and Check 2, one for each expect line and in order. Neither PASS nor FAIL condition requires npm test or the CSV tests. Check 1 compares the CSV and --tsv output byte for byte. Check 2 greps README.md for --tsv. The brief does ask the verifier to run npm test, but it labels that item "Advisory (not a PASS/FAIL condition)". It only asks for a note and gives no verdict, and the brief says "Give one verdict per check", so it is not a third check. The builder brief asks for npm test and a new test, but must_not only covers the verifier's checks and the PASS/FAIL conditions, so that is allowed.
